name: Homebound Runestone summons its marker creature (#4979)
contract: Homebound Runestone 560316 (Spell.dbc BaseLevel/SpellLevel 32) Effect0 is SPELL_EFFECT_SUMMON
(SummonProperties.dbc, a stock numSummons id native AzerothCore already handles). Before the fix,
entry 50058 had no creature_template row anywhere in the repo, so Spell::EffectSummonType's
SummonCreature(50058, ...) call silently returned null and nothing appeared. After the fix, a
living creature 50058 must exist near the caster shortly after the cast.

steps.label: SETUP: no Homebound Runestone marker exists yet
Casting Homebound Runestone summons creature 50058 near the caster
